title: A pain to assemble, and not very modular, if at all.
text:
A pain to assemble, and not very modular, if at all.. My thumbs were sore after spending half an hour assembling this. It's very straightforward (really, there's only two set of instructions you need to follow), but the way the included hex wrench and screws came made it so that the hex wrench kept slipping off the screws. I do not have a more ergonomic wrench, so the included one was all I used. After each pole is tightened, they tighten more and more, and you have to exert more force against your thumb while using the wrench, and meanwhile it slips every other rotation. After all was said and done, I took between 20-30 minutes just turning the screws.

Also, two of the poles were miscolored. I get that there can be some stain variation, but these were noticeably darker, almost a different color.

I thought the bins would be easily removable, but only the top ones are. You really have to push and pop the others into place. You can forcefully remove them, but after they have loads of toys in them it sort of defeats the purpose as the toys will come flying out, whether from the bin you're trying to remove or the one right above it. We know: we've done so!

The kids love it and it's a nice way to contain their toys they access most of the time.
